description: This file implements a C++ class MediaCodecBridge for interfacing with Android's media codec via JNI. It includes functions for creating, managing, and interacting with media codecs, handling errors, buffers, and format info, and converting media metadata to Android-specific formats.

classes.name: MediaCodecBridge
classes.description: A class that wraps JNI calls to Android's MediaCodec, providing methods to create, configure, and control media codecs, handle buffers, and report errors.

methods.name: CreateAudioMediaCodecBridge
methods.description: Creates and initializes a MediaCodecBridge for audio streams based on provided stream info.

methods.name: CreateVideoMediaCodecBridge
methods.description: Creates and initializes a MediaCodecBridge for video streams with specified parameters and optional color metadata.

methods.name: GetInputBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the input buffer at the specified index.

methods.name: QueueInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for decoding.

methods.name: QueueSecureInputBuffer
methods.description: Queues a secure input buffer with DRM info.

methods.name: GetOutputBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the output buffer at the specified index.

methods.name: ReleaseOutputBuffer
methods.description: Releases an output buffer, optionally rendering it.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the media.

methods.name: GetOutputSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size and crop info of the output.

methods.name: GetAudioOutputFormat
methods.description: Gets the audio output format details.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecInputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Handles notification that an input buffer is available.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecOutputBufferAvailable
methods.description: Handles notification that an output buffer is available.

methods.name: OnMediaCodecFrameRendered
methods.description: Handles notification that a frame has been rendered.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MediaCodecBridge with a JNI media codec object.
